description: Points distributed in four quadrants, with axes, labels and selection.

howToUse: Use it to place items by two criteria and see which quadrant each one falls in: impact and effort, risk and likelihood.
Name the axes with `xLabel` and `yLabel`, and each quadrant in `quadrants` ("Do now", "Plan").
Pass the `points` in order of priority; open the detail of the chosen point in `onPointClick`.
alternatives: A ranked list: Table with sorting.

keyboard.action: Moves from one point to the next, in order of priority.
Selects the point in focus, or clears it.

props.name: points
props.description: Points in priority order: color goes from critical (1st) to info (last).

props.name: quadrants
props.type: { topLeft?: ReactNode; topRight?: ReactNode; bottomLeft?: ReactNode; bottomRight?: ReactNode; } | undefined

props.name: legend
props.description: Legend of the priority scale (e.g. ["High priority", "low"]).

props.description: Fired when a point is clicked (or `null` when deselected).
